unsolicited_content.definition: The reply offers an action the user did not request, or adds information the request did not call for. Offering escalation is a failure only where ESC-1 to ESC-4 do not require it.
example_quotes: I also checked about returns for you — our return window is 30 days from the delivery date [cw-returns], and since this
I know that's disappointing especially since you never really opened it. If you'd like, I can escalate this to a human t
Your Rustic Beanie order already shipped.
unsolicited_content.boundary: Not this mode when ESC-1 to ESC-4 require escalation. Confirmed on 5 account_change traces where escalation is mandatory under ESC-2 and the reply was judged correct.

response_style.definition: The reply is repetitive or vague, restates the user's own words, or mirrors the user's emotional state beyond what the request requires.
example_quotes: It was delivered on June 2, which is past Meridian Cycles' 21-day return window
I know switching between logins is frustrating, thanks for hanging in there while they get this sorted for you.
That last-minute Target run for your niece's birthday sounds stressful — sorry you ended up with two gifts.
response_style.boundary: Distinct from unsolicited_content: the content belonged in the reply, the wording was poor.

redundant_tool_path.definition: Answering one question takes two or more overlapping tool calls, because no single tool returns the data the answer needs.
example_quotes: I found your order from June — I'll now check if it's still within the return window.
I found your order for the Classic Sticky Notes from Atlas Stationery — let me pull up the full details to confirm what
"store_name": "Cascade Audio",
redundant_tool_path.requirement: TOOL-10 (added by this review) — code requirement
redundant_tool_path.boundary: Distinct from ineffective_tool_strategy: here each call is reasonable and the tool set forces the overlap. There, the agent chose badly.

retracted.reason: Reviewer withdrew the interpretation 2026-09-22. find_order's refund_eligible is a boolean stamped at seed time; check_return_eligibility computes the window live and returns the policy_id RESP-1 requires. Calling both is not redundant.

ineffective_tool_strategy.definition: The agent ends its turn with the tool loop unfinished: it announces a lookup it never performs, replies that it cannot find a record while an untried lookup remains, or answers before a check the prompt requires. Also covers a query built from qualitative terms or values the user may be misremembering.
example_quotes: I searched your orders for the Classic Granola from Golden Hour Coffee, but I couldn't find a match in your recent order
I didn't find a $66.25 order in those results
If you can ask them to double-check their confirmation email for the store name and order number, I'm happy to help with
ineffective_tool_strategy.boundary: Not this mode where the agent completed its lookups and the tool itself failed (search_tool_failure), or where the data genuinely does not exist. The test is whether a further tool call was available and stated or implied.

search_tool_failure.definition: A search tool returns an error or omits a record matching the query, independent of what the agent did with the result.
example_quotes: I don't have live stock counts or ETA in my catalog search
"title": "Handmade Bluetooth Speaker"
search for that Portable Puzzle for you to find in-stock options.
search_tool_failure.requirement: TOOL-3, TOOL-11 (TOOL-11 added by this review) — code requirement
search_tool_failure.boundary: Distinct from ineffective_tool_strategy: the tool errored or omitted a match. There, the tool worked and the query was poor.

missing_threshold_escalation.definition: A return or refund whose order total is at or above the $100 threshold is not routed to a human, and the agent states or implies it can complete the request itself. Fires on the turn the agent makes that implication, not only where a refund was explicitly requested.
example_quotes:
ood news: it's still returnable. You have 30 of 30 days remaining in the return window [cw-returns].

Here's how the pro
Let me pull up Northwind Books' exact return policy so I give you the right steps
found your order for the Modern Novel — now I'll check whether it's still within the return window and why that matters
missing_threshold_escalation.boundary: Not this mode where the agent confirms eligibility and cites the policy without implying it can complete the request; ESC-5 permits that. Distinct from unsolicited_content: ESC-5 makes escalation required here, so RESP-6 does not apply.

unsupported_claim.definition: The reply asserts a fact, policy, capability, or completed action the tool results and the specification do not support, including citing the platform return window where a store override applies.
example_quotes: Got it — I'll help you with a refund for that damaged stove.I'll look up your recent orders to find that Sturdy Camp Sto
I know that's frustrating when you're still waiting for it, so let me check what our options are when a package shows de
ick heads-up: our dispute policy (cw-disputes) notes disputes can be opened up to 60 days after delivery, and this deliv
unsupported_claim.boundary: Distinct from response_style: the statement is wrong or unverifiable, not merely badly worded.

unauthorized_refusal.definition: The agent refuses an action the caller's role is permitted to perform under AUTH-1.
example_quotes: I can't share another customer's transaction details,
I can't share another shopper's order details, even when requested on their behalf.
Sorry, I can't look up or share another customer's order or charge details, even for a support case.
unauthorized_refusal.requirement: AUTH-1, AUTH-2 (AUTH-2 added by this review)
unauthorized_refusal.boundary: Not this mode when the caller is a merchant and the order belongs to another store (AUTH-1 limits merchants to their own store); confirmed on 3 merchant traces. Part C found the failing shape is a refusal issued without attempting the tool call at all.
